en: Reverse side of a vintage divided‑back postcard. It bears a U.S. green 1‑cent Benjamin Franklin stamp with a Dec 24 cancellation, a British royal coat of arms and Raphael Tuck & Sons imprint along the left edge. A handwritten Swedish holiday message appears on the left; the right side is addressed to Miss Kristina Anderson at Strawberry Hill, care of Mrs. Raymond, Stamford, Connecticut.
